newsitem.title: USA: Interneuron says to look at Redux effects.
newsitem.headline: Interneuron says to look at Redux effects.

text.p: Interneuron Pharmaceutical Inc and Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories said on Tuesday they would conduct a postmarketing clincial study on Redux.

The research, a Phase 4 clinical study, will examine any behavioral or psychological changes that occur in patients taking Redux, which works to reduce appetite by stimulating the release of serotonin in the brain.

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration cleared Redux for marketing in April 1996 at which time the two companies agreed to conduct a postmarket study to clarify the relevance of animal data on the product, the companies said in a statement.
Wyeth-Ayerst is a division of American Home Products Corp.
